name: Dongguan Aohai Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Dongguan Aohai Technology Co., Ltd. designs, research, develops, produces, and sells consumer electronics products in China and internationally. The company's products include smart phone chargers, adapters, server power supply, wireless chargers, power for PC and electric tools, portable energy storage, power bank, and smart home and outdoor appliances. Dongguan Aohai Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Dongguan, China.
